title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken tagine dish inspired by traditional Saudi Arabian cuisine. This slow-cooked stew is made with tender chicken, nourishing herbs, and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the honey and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or couscous, if desired.
